## What changes

<!-- One or two sentences. Link the issue. -->

## Type

- [ ] Major: changes a design rule, what a requirement means, a profile's assumptions or a bound
- [ ] Minor: adds a section, requirement, test or source
- [ ] Patch: wording, links or figures

## Checklist

- [ ] Section and figure links still point to the right numbers
- [ ] New claims cite primary sources in `references/references.yaml`, with `checked` dates
- [ ] Requirement and test IDs are unchanged, or retired rather than reused
- [ ] The README and the executive brief still agree with the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated (minor and major changes)
